<content>
*This section holds Strale's customer-facing vertical products. Each subpage is a distinct product with its own scope, coverage, and pricing. Underlying infrastructure (SQS, Audit Trail engine, Routing, Entity resolution, Decision-readiness, Discovery, Orchestration, Capabilities catalog, **`apps/api/coverage-matrix/`** in repo) lives in the Infrastructure section.*
**Counterparty Assurance is Strale's first vertical product.** (Renamed from Payee Assurance per DEC-20260502-A.) Future vertical products will be added as subpages here, earned through customer pull and strategic opportunity (per DEC-20260420-E's decision-adjacency expansion rule). The seven-vertical framework from DEC-20260413-A is now treated as a descriptive map of existing capability clusters, not a commitment to build out each one.
